WITH emp_counts AS (
    SELECT e."Company_ID" AS Company_ID,
           COUNT(*) AS total_emp,
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.Year_working <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.Year_working BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.Year_working >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_cnt
    FROM employment e
    GROUP BY e."Company_ID"
),
company_metrics AS (
    SELECT c."Company_ID",
           c.Market_Value_in_Billion,
           ec.total_emp,
           (c.Market_Value_in_Billion / NULLIF(ec.total_emp, 0)) AS mv_per_emp,
           ec.junior_cnt,
           ec.mid_cnt,
           ec.senior_cnt
    FROM company c
    JOIN emp_counts ec ON c."Company_ID" = ec.Company_ID
)
SELECT junior_cnt, mid_cnt, senior_cnt
FROM company_metrics
ORDER BY mv_per_emp DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT p."Name" AS employee_name,
       c."Name" AS company_name,
       CASE
           WHEN e."Year_working" > 5 THEN 'senior'
           WHEN e."Year_working" >= 3 THEN 'mid-level'
           ELSE 'junior'
       END AS seniority
FROM "people" p
JOIN "employment" e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID"
JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
WHERE c."Market_Value_in_Billion" > 200
  AND e."Year_working" > 5;

WITH emp AS (
    SELECT p.Name AS employee_name,
           c.Name AS company_name,
           e.Year_working,
           c.Market_Value_in_Billion,
           CASE
               WHEN e.Year_working < 3 THEN 'junior'
               WHEN e.Year_working BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'mid-level'
               ELSE 'senior'
           END AS seniority
    FROM "people" p
    JOIN "employment" e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
    JOIN "company" c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
)
SELECT employee_name, company_name, seniority
FROM emp
WHERE seniority = 'senior' AND Market_Value_in_Billion > 200;

votes.sql:
WITH cum_years AS (
    SELECT "People_ID", SUM("Year_working") AS total_years
    FROM employment
    GROUP BY "People_ID"
),
total_cnt AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cum_years
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT c."People_ID",
           c.total_years,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cum_years c2 WHERE c2.total_years < c.total_years) + 1 AS rnk
    FROM cum_years c
),
percentiles AS (
    SELECT r."People_ID",
           r.total_years,
           (r.rnk - 1) * 1.0 / (tc.cnt - 1) AS percentile_rank
    FROM ranked r, total_cnt tc
),
assets AS (
    SELECT e."People_ID",
           SUM(co."Assets_in_Billion") AS total_assets
    FROM employment e
    JOIN "company" co ON e."Company_ID" = co."Company_ID"
    GROUP BY e."People_ID"
)
SELECT p."Name",
       pt.percentile_rank,
       a.total_assets
FROM "people" p
JOIN percentiles pt ON p."People_ID" = pt."People_ID"
JOIN assets a ON p."People_ID" = a."People_ID"
WHERE p."Graduation_College" IN (
    'Harvard University',
    'Stanford University',
    'Massachusetts Institute of Technology',
    'University of Cambridge',
    'University of Oxford'
);

WITH 
qualifying_colleges AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Graduation_College
    FROM people
    ORDER BY Graduation_College
    LIMIT 5
),
person_cumulative_experience AS (
    SELECT 
        p.People_ID,
        SUM(e.Year_working) AS cumulative_years
    FROM people p
    INNER JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
    WHERE p.Graduation_College IN (SELECT Graduation_College FROM qualifying_colleges)
    GROUP BY p.People_ID
),
all_employees_experience AS (
    SELECT 
        p.People_ID,
        SUM(e.Year_working) AS employee_years
    FROM people p
    INNER JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
    GROUP BY p.People_ID
),
percentile_ranks AS (
    SELECT 
        pce.People_ID,
        pce.cumulative_years,
        CAST(
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_employees_experience aee 
             WHERE aee.employee_years <= pce.cumulative_years)
            AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_employees_experience) AS percentile_rank
    FROM person_cumulative_experience pce
),
person_assets AS (
    SELECT 
        p.People_ID,
        SUM(c.Assets_in_Billion) AS total_company_assets
    FROM people p
    INNER JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
    INNER JOIN company c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
    WHERE p.Graduation_College IN (SELECT Graduation_College FROM qualifying_colleges)
    GROUP BY p.People_ID
)
SELECT 
    pr.percentile_rank,
    pa.total_company_assets
FROM percentile_ranks pr
INNER JOIN person_assets pa ON pr.People_ID = pa.People_ID
ORDER BY pr.percentile_rank;

WITH grads AS (
    SELECT People_ID, Name
    FROM people
    WHERE Graduation_College IN ('Harvard','Stanford','MIT','University of Cambridge','University of California Berkeley')
),
exp AS (
    SELECT People_ID, SUM(Year_working) AS cum_years
    FROM employment
    GROUP BY People_ID
),
assets AS (
    SELECT e.People_ID, SUM(c.Assets_in_Billion) AS total_assets
    FROM employment e
    JOIN company c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
    GROUP BY e.People_ID
)
SELECT g.Name,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY exp.cum_years) AS percentile_rank,
       a.total_assets
FROM grads g
JOIN exp ON g.People_ID = exp.People_ID
JOIN assets a ON g.People_ID = a.People_ID;

votes.sql:
WITH emp_agg AS (
    SELECT
        e."People_ID",
        SUM(e."Year_working") AS total_years,
        AVG(c."Market_Value_in_Billion") AS avg_market_value
    FROM "employment" e
    JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
    GROUP BY e."People_ID"
),
seniority AS (
    SELECT
        People_ID,
        total_years,
        avg_market_value,
        CASE
            WHEN total_years < 3 THEN 'junior'
            WHEN total_years <= 7 THEN 'mid-level'
            ELSE 'senior'
        END AS seniority_level
    FROM emp_agg
)
SELECT
    seniority_level,
    AVG(avg_market_value) AS average_market_value
FROM seniority
GROUP BY seniority_level
ORDER BY seniority_level;

SELECT c."Industry" AS industry,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e."Year_working" <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e."Year_working" BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_level,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e."Year_working" > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior
FROM "employment" e
JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
GROUP BY c."Industry"
ORDER BY c."Industry";

SELECT "Name"
FROM (
  SELECT p."Name",
         p."Nationality",
         c."Market_Value_in_Billion" * 0.85 AS MarketValue_EUR,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY p."Nationality"
           ORDER BY (c."Market_Value_in_Billion" * 0.85) - avg_n.avg_market_value DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM "people" p
  JOIN "employment" e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID"
  JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
  JOIN (
    SELECT p2."Nationality",
           AVG(c2."Market_Value_in_Billion" * 0.85) AS avg_market_value
    FROM "people" p2
    JOIN "employment" e2 ON p2."People_ID" = e2."People_ID"
    JOIN "company" c2 ON e2."Company_ID" = c2."Company_ID"
    GROUP BY p2."Nationality"
  ) avg_n ON p."Nationality" = avg_n."Nationality"
) sub
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY sub."Nationality", sub.rn;

SELECT
    "Name",
    "Sales_in_Billion" AS original_sales_in_billions,
    "Sales_in_Billion" * 1000000000 AS converted_sales_in_euros,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Sales_in_Billion" * 1000000000 DESC) AS rank
FROM "company"
WHERE "Sales_in_Billion" * 1000000000 > (
    SELECT AVG("Sales_in_Billion" * 1000000000) FROM "company"
);

SELECT p."Name", p."Nationality",
       SUM(p."Age" * c."Market_Value_in_Billion" * 0.93) AS "total_euro"
FROM "people" AS p
JOIN "employment" AS e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID"
JOIN "company"   AS c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID"
ORDER BY "total_euro" DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    p.Name,
    p.Nationality,
    SUM(p.Age * c.Market_Value_in_Billion * 0.93) AS Euro_Adjusted_Total
FROM people p
JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
JOIN company c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
GROUP BY p.People_ID
ORDER BY Euro_Adjusted_Total DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT p."Name" AS Name,
       p."Nationality" AS Nationality,
       SUM(p."Age" * c."Market_Value_in_Billion" * 0.93) AS euro_total
FROM "people" p
JOIN "employment" e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID"
JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name", p."Nationality"
ORDER BY euro_total DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p."Name",
       SUM(DISTINCT c."Market_Value_in_Billion") AS cumulative_market_value
FROM "people" p
JOIN "employment" e ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
JOIN "company" c ON c."Company_ID" = e."Company_ID"
GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name"
HAVING SUM(e."Year_working") >= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(e."Year_working") >= 10 THEN 1
              WHEN SUM(e."Year_working") >= 5 THEN 2
              ELSE 3 END,
         cumulative_market_value DESC;

SELECT 
    p.Name,
    SUM(c.Market_Value_in_Billion) AS cumulative_market_value_billion
FROM people p
JOIN employment e ON p.People_ID = e.People_ID
JOIN company c ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
GROUP BY p.People_ID
HAVING SUM(e.Year_working) >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(e.Year_working) DESC, cumulative_market_value_billion DESC;

SELECT "Name", "cumulative_market_value" FROM (SELECT p."People_ID", p."Name", SUM(e."Year_working") AS "total_years", SUM(c."Market_Value_in_Billion") AS "cumulative_market_value" FROM "people" p JOIN "employment" e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID" JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID" GROUP BY p."People_ID", p."Name") WHERE "total_years" >= 10 ORDER BY "cumulative_market_value" DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH industry_stats AS (
    SELECT "Industry",
           AVG("Sales_in_Billion") AS avg_sales,
           AVG("Profits_in_Billion") AS avg_profits,
           AVG("Assets_in_Billion") AS avg_assets
    FROM "company"
    GROUP BY "Industry"
),
premium_companies AS (
    SELECT c."Company_ID"
    FROM "company" c
    JOIN industry_stats i ON c."Industry" = i."Industry"
    WHERE c."Sales_in_Billion" >= i.avg_sales
      AND c."Profits_in_Billion" >= i.avg_profits
      AND c."Assets_in_Billion" >= i.avg_assets
)
SELECT DISTINCT p."Name"
FROM premium_companies pc
JOIN "employment" e ON pc."Company_ID" = e."Company_ID"
JOIN "people" p ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID";
